import threading
from cachetools import cachedmethod, LRUCache

counter = [0]

class MyClass:
    @cachedmethod(lambda self: LRUCache(10), condition=threading.Condition())
    def f(self, x):
        counter[0] += 1
        return x * 2

obj = MyClass()
import concurrent.futures
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as ex:
    list(ex.map(obj.f, [1] * 10))
print(f"Function called {counter[0]} time(s)")
assert counter[0] == 1, f"Expected 1, got {counter[0]}"
